courses.title: Sleep Loop - Digital Download
courses.description: An 80-minute recorded crystal singing bowl meditation by Jeralyn Glass, made for listening as you fall asleep. It pairs celestial-sounding bowl tones with gentle affirmations of safety, renewal and letting go.

left_out: Healing Transmission at 528 Hz (https://www.crystalcadence.com/shop/p/healing-transmission-at-528-hz-recording-digital-download): the page calls 528 Hz the frequency of 'DNA repair', a physical healing claim; health rule.

Healing Transmission for the Endocrine System (https://www.crystalcadence.com/shop/p/healing-transmission-for-the-endocrine-system-digital-download): sold as supporting the endocrine system and 'the balance of the body chemistry', a claim about a body system; health rule. Both transmissions were also made for Dr. Sue Morter's monthly transmissions.
